connector.name: MCP Server by pingvalid.com
connector.registryDescription: Email validation for Claude and any MCP client - verdicts with evidence, bulk jobs, refunds.
connector.summary: Hosted at pingvalid.com over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.pingvalid, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer pv_live_… — a pingvalid API key. Create at https://pingvalid.com/dashboard/api-keys
